messages.subject: Reminder of the International Statistical Ecology Conference
parts:
Please read and distribute the following notice regarding the
International Statistical Ecology Conference

A poster publicising the ISEC2010 meeting to be held in Canterbury,
Kent, England in July is to be found at:

http://www.britishandirish.tibs.org/live/ISECposter.pdf

The early-bird registration date is March 31st, 2010 (less than 3 weeks
from now). Please also visit the conference website
http://www.ncse.org.uk/isec2010

--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
